headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2022: the AEW World Tag Team Titles found a new home as The Young Bucks vs. Jurassic Express battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.49 ? one of the better matches of the year ? ending the champion's reign at 6 defenses. This wild ladder match saw four tables broken in the closing stretch, and ended with a stunned Christian Cage turning on Jungle Boy the moment the bell rang.

Rewind to 2024, when Shane Haste made their AEW debut against TMDK vs. Bryan Danielson vs. Claudio Castagnoli vs. Jon Moxley vs. Wheeler Yuta vs. Mikey Nicholls vs. Lio Rush vs. Rocky Romero, appearing on Collision, rated 6.78.
It was 2022 when Will Ospreay vs. Dax Harwood crossed paths for the first time ever on Dynamite, rated 8.49 ? a real highlight of the night.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2022, Road Rager '22 - Night 1 stood out as one of AEW's best-received shows of the year, rated 8.50.
Flash back to 2022, when Miro vs. Ethan Page met for the very first time on Dynamite, rated 5.39.
It was 2024 when Dante Martin vs. Lee Moriarty met in a Qualifying Match on Collision, rated 5.72, part of the special One Year Anniversary card.
